recipe_desc: Mid-cycle underwrite: normalized operating margin on a mid-cycle revenue base, valued at an exit EV/LTM-EBITDA multiple; reward/risk measured at SPOT.

d_and_a.source: 10-K acc 0000793074-26-000071 — CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME, 'Depreciation and amortization'

net_debt.basis: incl. operating + finance leases, as of 2026-03-31
net_debt.source: 10-Q acc 0000793074-26-000096 balance sheet — LT debt 8.600 + 869.600 + finance leases 26.706 + 26.878 + operating leases 48.832 + 60.704 - cash & equivalents 61.544 = 979.776

diluted_shares.basis: The filer reports NO dilutive difference for 2026-01-01→2026-03-31 (basic and diluted weighted averages are equal at 59,910,000), so the diluted denominator equals the basic outstanding count of 59,950,115. This is a reported zero, not an unchecked one. Excluded from the filer's diluted average: antidilutive instruments (a loss period reports no dilution at all under ASC 260); out-of-the-money options, which contribute nothing under the treasury-stock method; any change in the dilutive count between the reporting period and the valuation date.

cash_tax_rate.basis: ANALYST ASSUMPTION, not a filing figure — normalized cash-tax rate for the FCF cross-check only; does not touch value/share

bear.reason: trough persists; One-Way keeps shrinking; underlying FY25 ex the Q2 insurance credit was ~breakeven, so 1.5% is slight lift off a ~0% floor.

base.reason: Set below the 7.45% full-history screening median: the insurance run-rate is about 125bps higher (2018-22 average 4.06% against 2025-26 underlying ~5.3%, excluding the one-off Q2-25 favourable credit), and about 50bps comes off for the Dedicated mix shift from 51.5% to 73%, which caps One-Way upside in peak-margin years. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

bull.reason: genuine cycle turn: One-Way rebounds on tight capacity + driver-supply tightening; Dedicated fully loaded. Below TTS-segment peaks of 12–14% (FY20–22: 12.04/13.78/12.13%; consolidated 9.6–11.3%) (One-Way exposure reduced; insurance ~125bps higher) [amended 2026-07-21: scoped to segment level — consolidated record 9.59/11.31/9.82%, FY22 10-K segment footnote].

revenue.method: Legs set against reported history: bear holds a trough below FY2025 with continued One-Way shrink; base is a modest cyclical recovery above FY2025; bull sits just above the FY2022 peak on a genuine cycle turn.

verdict.rationale: WATCH at $46. The underwrite fails our 2:1 bar — the base case values the business roughly 22% below the market price, so the recovery is already paid for. A sound franchise at the wrong price, not a broken one. We revisit below about $28–30, or on evidence that normal profitability is genuinely higher than the company's own history suggests.
reunderwrite_triggers: a reported quarter proving normalized operating margin genuinely >7.5% (e.g. disclosed Dedicated segment economics, or a clean beat)
verdict.avoid_priced_note: inverted asymmetry at 46 (upside +6% to bull, downside -22% base / -64% bear) -> track for avoid-leg short-alpha on paper.
